import subprocess
import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

# Imports
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import linregress, t, spearmanr

# Try to import MNE
try:
    import mne
    from mne.time_frequency import tfr_array_morlet
except ImportError:
    install('mne')
    import mne
    from mne.time_frequency import tfr_array_morlet

# Parameters
sessions = list(range(1, 11))
freqs = np.arange(30, 71, 5)  # 30 to 70 Hz
n_cycles = 7.  # fixed number of cycles for all freqs

tmin, tmax = -0.2, 0.5
baseline = (tmin, 0.0)
post_window = (0.05, 0.2)

session_gamma = []

for sess in sessions:
    meg_file = f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5'
    with h5py.File(meg_file, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]  # (306, n_times)
        times = f['times'][:]
        sfreq = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_types = f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')
    mag_idx = [i for i, t in enumerate(ch_types) if t.strip().lower() == 'mag']

    ev_file = f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv'
    events = pd.read_csv(ev_file, sep='\t')
    words = events[events['kind'] == 'word']

    epochs = []
    n_samples = int((tmax - tmin) * sfreq)
    pre_samples = int(-tmin * sfreq)
    for onset in words['timemeg'].values:
        idx0 = np.searchsorted(times, onset)
        start = idx0 - pre_samples
        stop = start + n_samples
        if start < 0 or stop > data.shape[1]:
            continue
        ep = data[np.ix_(mag_idx, np.arange(start, stop))]
        epochs.append(ep)
    if not epochs:
        print(f"Session {sess}: No valid epochs")
        session_gamma.append(np.nan)
        continue
    epochs = np.array(epochs)  # (n_epochs, n_ch, n_times)

    # Time-frequency: power (n_epochs, n_ch, n_freqs, n_times)
    power = tfr_array_morlet(epochs, sfreq, freqs, n_cycles=n_cycles,
                              output='power', zero_mean=True)

    # Time vector for epoch
    times_epoch = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, power.shape[-1])
    # Baseline indices
    bidx = np.where((times_epoch >= baseline[0]) & (times_epoch < baseline[1]))[0]
    # Post-onset indices
    pidx = np.where((times_epoch >= post_window[0]) & (times_epoch <= post_window[1]))[0]

    # Baseline correction (relative change)
    baseline_mean = power[..., bidx].mean(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    power_bc = (power - baseline_mean) / baseline_mean

    # Mean gamma power per epoch
    # average over freqs and times, then channels and epochs
    gamma_vals = power_bc[..., pidx].mean(axis=-1).mean(axis=-1)  # (n_epochs,)
    mean_gamma = np.mean(gamma_vals)
    session_gamma.append(mean_gamma)
    print(f"Session {sess}: mean gamma = {mean_gamma:.3e} ({len(gamma_vals)} epochs)")

# Regression
x = np.array(sessions)
y = np.array(session_gamma)
mask = ~np.isnan(y)
xm, ym = x[mask], y[mask]
res = linregress(xm, ym)
# 95% CI for slope
df = len(xm) - 2
tcrit = t.ppf(1-0.025, df)
slope_ci = (res.slope - tcrit*res.stderr, res.slope + tcrit*res.stderr)

print("\n=== Session-wise Gamma Power ===")
for sess, g in zip(sessions, session_gamma):
    print(f"Session {sess}: {g:.3e}")
print(f"\nLinear regression: slope={res.slope:.2e}, 95% CI=({slope_ci[0]:.2e}, {slope_ci[1]:.2e}), p={res.pvalue:.3f}")
# Spearman
rho, p_s = spearmanr(xm, ym)
print(f"Spearman rho={rho:.3f}, p={p_s:.3f}\n")

# Plot gamma vs session
plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
plt.scatter(x, y, label='Data')
plt.plot(xm, res.intercept + res.slope*xm, 'r--', label='Fit')
plt.xlabel('Session')
plt.ylabel('Mean induced gamma power (baseline-corrected)')
plt.title('Session-wise Gamma Power Trend')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

{"code":"import subprocess
import sys

def install(package):
    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--quiet", package])

# Imports
import h5py
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import linregress, t, spearmanr

# Try to import MNE
try:
    import mne
    from mne.time_frequency import tfr_array_morlet
except ImportError:
    install('mne')
    import mne
    from mne.time_frequency import tfr_array_morlet

# Parameters
sessions = list(range(1, 11))
freqs = np.arange(30, 71, 5)  # 30 to 70 Hz
n_cycles = 7.  # fixed number of cycles for all freqs

tmin, tmax = -0.2, 0.5
baseline = (tmin, 0.0)
post_window = (0.05, 0.2)

session_gamma = []

for sess in sessions:
    meg_file = f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5'
    with h5py.File(meg_file, 'r') as f:
        data = f['data'][:]  # (306, n_times)
        times = f['times'][:]
        sfreq = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
        ch_types = f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')
    mag_idx = [i for i, t in enumerate(ch_types) if t.strip().lower() == 'mag']

    ev_file = f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv'
    events = pd.read_csv(ev_file, sep='\t')
    words = events[events['kind'] == 'word']

    epochs = []
    n_samples = int((tmax - tmin) * sfreq)
    pre_samples = int(-tmin * sfreq)
    for onset in words['timemeg'].values:
        idx0 = np.searchsorted(times, onset)
        start = idx0 - pre_samples
        stop = start + n_samples
        if start < 0 or stop > data.shape[1]:
            continue
        ep = data[np.ix_(mag_idx, np.arange(start, stop))]
        epochs.append(ep)
    if not epochs:
        print(f"Session {sess}: No valid epochs")
        session_gamma.append(np.nan)
        continue
    epochs = np.array(epochs)  # (n_epochs, n_ch, n_times)

    # Time-frequency: power (n_epochs, n_ch, n_freqs, n_times)
    power = tfr_array_morlet(epochs, sfreq, freqs, n_cycles=n_cycles,
                              output='power', zero_mean=True)

    # Time vector for epoch
    times_epoch = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, power.shape[-1])
    # Baseline indices
    bidx = np.where((times_epoch >= baseline[0]) & (times_epoch < baseline[1]))[0]
    # Post-onset indices
    pidx = np.where((times_epoch >= post_window[0]) & (times_epoch <= post_window[1]))[0]

    # Baseline correction (relative change)
    baseline_mean = power[..., bidx].mean(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
    power_bc = (power - baseline_mean) / baseline_mean

    # Mean gamma power per epoch
    # average over freqs and times, then channels and epochs
    gamma_vals = power_bc[..., pidx].mean(axis=-1).mean(axis=-1)  # (n_epochs,)
    mean_gamma = np.mean(gamma_vals)
    session_gamma.append(mean_gamma)
    print(f"Session {sess}: mean gamma = {mean_gamma:.3e} ({len(gamma_vals)} epochs)")

# Regression
x = np.array(sessions)
y = np.array(session_gamma)
mask = ~np.isnan(y)
xm, ym = x[mask], y[mask]
res = linregress(xm, ym)
# 95% CI for slope
df = len(xm) - 2
tcrit = t.ppf(1-0.025, df)
slope_ci = (res.slope - tcrit*res.stderr, res.slope + tcrit*res.stderr)

print("\n=== Session-wise Gamma Power ===")
for sess, g in zip(sessions, session_gamma):
    print(f"Session {sess}: {g:.3e}")
print(f"\nLinear regression: slope={res.slope:.2e}, 95% CI=({slope_ci[0]:.2e}, {slope_ci[1]:.2e}), p={res.pvalue:.3f}")
# Spearman
rho, p_s = spearmanr(xm, ym)
print(f"Spearman rho={rho:.3f}, p={p_s:.3f}\n")

# Plot gamma vs session
plt.figure(figsize=(8,5))
plt.scatter(x, y, label='Data')
plt.plot(xm, res.intercept + res.slope*xm, 'r--', label='Fit')
plt.xlabel('Session')
plt.ylabel('Mean induced gamma power (baseline-corrected)')
plt.title('Session-wise Gamma Power Trend')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

# Example spectrogram for session 5
sess = 5
meg_file = f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_meg.h5'
with h5py.File(meg_file, 'r') as f:
    data5 = f['data'][:]
    times5 = f['times'][:]
    sfreq5 = f.attrs['sample_frequency']
    ch_types5 = f.attrs['channel_types'].split(',')
mag5 = [i for i, t in enumerate(ch_types5) if t.strip().lower() == 'mag']

ev5 = pd.read_csv(f'sub-0_ses-{sess}_events.tsv', sep='\t')
words5 = ev5[ev5['kind'] == 'word']

epochs5 = []
pre5 = int(-tmin * sfreq5)
n_samp5 = int((tmax - tmin) * sfreq5)
for onset in words5['timemeg'].values[:200]:  # limit
    idx0 = np.searchsorted(times5, onset)
    start = idx0 - pre5
    stop = start + n_samp5
    if start < 0 or stop > data5.shape[1]:
        continue
    ep = data5[np.ix_(mag5, np.arange(start, stop))]
    epochs5.append(ep)
epochs5 = np.array(epochs5)
pw5 = tfr_array_morlet(epochs5, sfreq5, freqs, n_cycles=n_cycles,
                         output='power', zero_mean=True)
# avg over epochs and channels
spect = pw5.mean(axis=0).mean(axis=0)

times_e5 = np.linspace(tmin, tmax, spect.shape[1])
plt.figure(figsize=(6,5))
plt.pcolormesh(times_e5, freqs, spect, shading='auto')
plt.axvline(0, color='k', linestyle='--')
plt.xlabel('Time (s)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency (Hz)')
plt.title('Induced Gamma Spectrogram (Session 5)')
plt.colorbar(label='Power')
plt.show()
